DECISION: Ship Windows v1 with Whisper+Vulkan only. Parakeet ONNX (parakeet-rs 0.3.4 + DirectML) deferred to v2.
REASONING: parakeet-rs is v0.3 (pre-stable), ~200MB DLL overhead for ONNX Runtime + DirectML.dll, DirectML edge cases. Whisper large-v3 + Vulkan is real-time on any mid-range GPU.
BUILD ENVIRONMENT:
  - UTM on M4 Pro Mac with Windows 11 ARM64 (from microsoft.com/en-us/software-download/windows11arm64)
  - Windows 11 ARM is near-native speed in UTM (no x86 emulation for OS itself)
  - Install: Vulkan SDK (LunarG), Visual Studio Build Tools (C++ workload), Rust toolchain (MSVC target), Node.js
  - Claude Code runs natively on Windows in UTM — clone repo there, build, test
PARAKEET V2 PLAN:
  - parakeet-rs 0.3.4 with features=["directml"]
  - ExecutionConfig: DirectML EP, sequential mode, memory_pattern=false
  - Ship DirectML.dll + onnxruntime.dll next to .exe
  - ONNX models: istupakov/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-onnx (~670MB int8 quantized)
